consequence.statement: The `-s3.sse-encryption` flag is no longer recognized or honored by Loki; configurations using this flag will be ignored and S3 encryption settings must be specified using the `-s3.sse.*` settings instead.
consequence.remediation: Replace any `-s3.sse-encryption` configuration with the equivalent `-s3.sse.*` settings.

assertion.statement: The deprecated CLI flag `-s3.sse-encryption` has been removed in favor of the `-s3.sse.*` settings.
